tests.title: matches native framecrc for distances, temperatures, dry/wet mixes, rates and source formats into f64 and s16
writes native-identical f64le, s16le and WAV files with the longest delay and output time selection
matches native output for empty input
refuses unsupported options before output, with native status for each case
refuses a ring beyond the buffer budget before output, where native allocates it
parses named and positional options and refuses expressions, enable, unknown names and out-of-range values with exact messages
computes the delay from the macro transcription, truncating toward zero
negotiates pinned dblp for every input format and keeps counts, packet sections and planned reservations
matches the C transcription across ring wraps, delay 0 and arbitrary frame splits, keeping timestamps and owning output
converts packed and integer input to dblp, enforces allocation and format limits, and stops on abort

detail: 600 framecrc byte comparisons: u8/s16/s32/f32/f64 raw input x 8000/44100/48000 Hz x mono/stereo x pcm_f64le/pcm_s16le x 10 chains (Linux x64 gate, -cpuflags 0)
48 output file byte comparisons: s16/f64 input, 44100 Hz stereo, 16181-sample maximum delay and 3 m delay, output -ss/-t/-frames:a, f64le/s16le/WAV (Linux x64 gate)
14 native exit statuses for refused option forms (9 native failures, 5 native-accepted forms refused here)
1 native exit status for the large-ring case refused here with resource-budget

unsupported: FLAC input (refused before decoding; flacInput not declared)
option expressions and exponents (e.g. cm=10+5, dry=1e-1)
non-integer values for mm/cm/m/temp, which native rounds
signs on dry/wet and escaped/quoted option values
automatic sample-rate conversion around the step
rings larger than the buffer budget / maxFrameBytes (native allocates them)

proposedContracts.name: matches native framecrc for distances, temperatures, dry/wet mixes, rates and source formats into f64 and s16
writes native-identical f64le, s16le and WAV files with the longest delay and output time selection
matches native output for empty input
refuses unsupported options before output, with native status for each case
refuses a ring beyond the buffer budget before output, where native allocates it
parses named and positional options and refuses expressions, enable, unknown names and out-of-range values with exact messages
computes the delay from the macro transcription, truncating toward zero
negotiates pinned dblp for every input format and keeps counts, packet sections and planned reservations
matches the C transcription across ring wraps, delay 0 and arbitrary frame splits, keeping timestamps and owning output
converts packed and integer input to dblp, enforces allocation and format limits, and stops on abort

notes: formats() is the native ['dblp']; no negotiate/nativeFormats; not transparent because dry/wet change values.
Ring is delay+1 doubles per channel instead of native's pow2(sample_rate*COMP_DELAY_MAX_DELAY); output identical, checked in the unit test against a transcription of native's masked pow2 ring.
reserve() declares 1 frame plus (delay+1)*channels*8 stateBytes; the PCM path refuses an oversized ring with resource-budget before output.
A one-off ring-offset mutation made the framecrc differential fail, confirming it detects delay errors.
Setup durations: submodule update 49 s, npm ci 9 s, reference:build 198 s, baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries 60 s, baseline unit 89 s.
No shared edits beyond the registry line were needed.
